channel.title: CIS 120 – Web Foundations :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description The Internet, web browsers, and web-page-development technology: web-page design and implementation with Hypertext Markup Language (HTML), CSS, and JavaScript utilizing a modern webpage design. Students will also get hands-on experience deploying their own website. Course Overview This course. Course Goals and Learning Outcomes Create valid HTML webpages using separation of concerns with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Design web pages with a focus on accessibility. Utilize CSS rules to create engaging and responsive web page designs. Use JavaScript to dynamically modify the structure and appearance of a webpage. Employ JavaScript to interact with Web APIs to exchange data. Think critically about web page design and apply industry standard web page design principles. Course Prerequisites None/varies by topic. Instructor permission required.
